evidence.snippet: We introduce SpeechDx, a large-scale benchmark for clinical speech AI spanning 12 datasets and 27 tasks across diverse health conditions.

claire_radar.motivation: Speech offers a uniquely informative window into health by simultaneously engaging neurological, motor, respiratory, and vocal systems.

source.title: SpeechDx: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Clinical Speech AI

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Clinical speech AI lacks comparable evaluation across conditions. SpeechDx provides a shared framework to assess generalization and representation quality, guiding progress toward general-purpose models.
